quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 R&D investment RMB 1,298,697,340.60, 7.24% of revenue (expensed RMB 773,208,567.11, capitalized RMB 525,488,773.49, capitalization 40.46%); 2,808 R&D staff, 17.64% of employees. At December 31, 2025 the company held more than 4,600 patents (including applications), 2,778 of them granted. Completed projects include 8-inch N-type SiC crystal low-dislocation growth (in mass production; higher 8-inch crystal yield and lower substrate cost), 6-inch N-type SiC fast low-defect crystal growth, a 6-inch SiC trench MOSFET process, third-generation SiC MOSFETs (a 1200V 14/20/120 milliohm series, with a 3.5um cell-pitch platform released to the foundry line), high-voltage high-current automotive GaN power chips for EV powertrains, GaN-on-silicon epitaxy now sold as epi wafers, and 6-inch Micro LED red chips.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 1,298,697,340.60, 7.24% of revenue; 2,808 R&D staff; 2,778 granted patents

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Power electronics (2025 annual report): Hunan Sanan is a vertically integrated SiC platform (crystal growth, substrate, epitaxy, chip) with 6-inch SiC capacity of 16,000 wafers a month, 8-inch SiC 1,000 wafers a month and GaN-on-silicon 2,000 wafers a month; 2025 revenue RMB 9.10 hundred million, net profit RMB -3.23 hundred million. It offers SiC diodes from 650V to 2000V and SiC MOSFETs from 650V to 2000V (12 to 1000 milliohm). Automotive: SiC MOSFET shipments for on-board chargers and air-conditioning compressors kept growing; main-drive inverter SiC MOSFETs passed validation at a leading domestic EV maker and entered validation at several overseas Tier 1 customers. PV and storage: SiC SBDs and MOSFETs in stable volume delivery to Sungrow, GoodWe, Ginlong, Growatt, Sineng, Aiswei and Deye. Low-altitude economy: volume supply to power-supply customer Megmeet. White goods: volume production in Midea and Gree 2-3 HP air-conditioner projects. GaN-on-silicon 650V and 100V devices were developed with leading customers for next-generation AI server power systems and humanoid-robot joint motors. SiC substrates for heat sinks have been sampled to leading customers and diamond heat-sink substrates ship in small batches; optical-grade SiC for AI/AR glasses is delivered in small batches to several customers.
quarterly_data.figure: Hunan Sanan 2025 revenue RMB 9.10 hundred million, net profit RMB -3.23 hundred million; 6-inch SiC 16,000 wafers/month, 8-inch 1,000 wafers/month

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data-center and AI server power (2025 annual report): the company says its SiC devices are in volume production for leading customers Great Wall, Vertiv, Flex, Delta and Lite-On; it has deep strategic cooperation with several customers and has signed long-term non-cancellable orders, and it is developing HVDC high-voltage DC power solutions with several customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SiC joint venture with STMicroelectronics (2025 annual report): Anyifa, set up in Chongqing by Hunan Sanan and STMicroelectronics, produces SiC epitaxy and chips sold exclusively to STMicroelectronics; existing capacity 2,000 wafers a week, planned 8-inch epitaxy and chip capacity 48 ten-thousand wafers a year at full ramp; some products have completed validation and entered risk production; 2025 revenue RMB 0.29 hundred million. Wholly owned Chongqing Sanan makes the SiC substrates supplied to Anyifa: existing capacity 3,000 wafers a month, planned 8-inch substrate capacity 48 ten-thousand wafers a year; the Chongqing SiC substrate project (budget RMB 70.00 hundred million) had cumulative investment of RMB 10.26 hundred million (14.66%) at end-2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Anyifa 2025 revenue RMB 0.29 hundred million; 2,000 wafers/week now, 48 ten-thousand wafers/year planned; Chongqing substrate 3,000 wafers/month

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Major investment projects at end-2025: Hunan Sanan SiC semiconductor project (SiC and GaN-on-silicon, about 36 ten-thousand wafers a year of capacity at full ramp) budget RMB 160.00 hundred million, RMB 29.07 hundred million invested in 2025, cumulative RMB 204.37 hundred million (127.73% of budget), 39.40 ten-thousand square meters built and in use, 4,829 tools on site; Hubei Sanan Mini/Micro display project budget RMB 120.00 hundred million, cumulative RMB 31.47 hundred million (26.23%), adding about 236 ten-thousand chip wafers a year (4-inch equivalent) and 8.4 ten-thousand 4K display packaging units a year at full ramp, chip capacity now 12.5 ten-thousand wafers a month and special packaging 1,000KK a month, 2025 revenue RMB 6.25 hundred million and net profit RMB 0.37 hundred million. Construction in progress fell 49.86% to RMB 2,421,289,522.89 as projects were transferred to fixed assets; cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets fell 47.19% to RMB 1,430,105,121.69, mainly on lower Hunan Sanan construction spending.
quarterly_data.figure: Hunan SiC project cumulative RMB 204.37 hundred million of RMB 160.00 hundred million budget; Hubei Mini/Micro RMB 31.47 hundred million of RMB 120.00 hundred million; CIP RMB 2,421,289,522.89 (-49.86%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: RF front end and filters (2025 annual report): GaAs RF foundry (HBT, pHEMT) capacity 1.8 ten-thousand wafers a month, serving domestic design houses with end customers among domestic and overseas mainstream phone brands; shipments of its HP56 high-reliability, high-linearity process for advanced 5G RF modules rose at strategic customers. SAW filter capacity 150KK a month; filter line utilization improved and wafer-level-packaged (WLP) filter products began mass production; lithium tantalate and lithium niobate technology entered production. GaN RF ships stably to leading domestic base-station customers; a 0.25-micron gate mmWave product reached mass production; aerospace-grade GaAs and GaN RF chips are in volume supply for satellite payloads and ground terminals.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LED business (2025 annual report): the company is a main supplier of Mini RGB wide-colour-gamut TV backlight solutions to leading domestic and overseas customers; Micro LED MiP products ship in volume. For AI data-center high-speed optical interconnect it works with Tsinghua University and China Mobile on Micro LED optoelectronic devices, and its Micro LED products have been sampled to leading domestic and overseas companies for module-assembly validation. GaAs multi-junction solar cells are in volume supply for commercial satellite power. Automotive lamp subsidiary Anrui won 22 new project nominations in 2025 and supplied new models of Chery, Dongfeng Nissan and GM in volume.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Imported equipment suppliers named in the 2025 annual report (letters of credit at year-end): for Hunan Sanan's SiC lines, SiC epitaxy furnaces from LPE, ion implanters from Axcelis, WAT testers from Raytrex, e-beam inspection, PVD and metal etch tools from Applied Materials, rapid-anneal and high-temperature oxidation furnaces from centrotherm, coaters from Tokyo Electron, metal lift-off tools from Veeco, plasma strippers and UV curing tools from Trymax and etch tools from Scientech; for Quanzhou Sanan, dicing, cleaning and planarization tools from Tokyo Seimitsu, developers from Advanced System Technology and graphite susceptors from Schunk Xycarb.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (2025 annual report): the company will raise the share of high-end LED products (automotive LED, Mini/Micro LED, GaAs solar cells, horticultural lighting) to lift LED profitability, and accelerate customer adoption of its SiC and optical products and its RF-foundry and filter share to raise integrated-circuit equipment utilization, sales and profitability. It says some LED product prices have bottomed and rebounded since early 2026. Hedge: parts of the integrated-circuit business are still ramping; if demand growth or the capacity ramp falls short of expectations, the main business may keep losing money.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The planned acquisition of 100% of Lumileds Holding B.V. together with Inari Amertron Berhad was terminated: CFIUS found the deal raised unresolvable US national-security risk, and the parties withdrew the CFIUS filing and abandoned the transaction on April 17, 2026.
